verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਅਨੇਕ ਉਪਜਾਤ ਸੁਤ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਦੈ ਦੈ ਬਨਜ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਹਿ ਲਗਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maataa pitaa anek upajaat sut poo(n)jee dhai dhai banaj biauhaareh lagaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as parents give birth and raise many children and then support them with money and material to put them into trading business;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਬਿਰਤ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਲ ਖੋਵੈ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਭ ਲਭਤਿ ਕੈ ਚਉਗੁਨੋ ਬਢਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kirat birat kar kouoo mool khovai rovai kouoo laabh labhat kai chauguno baddaavahee ||

en.bdb: And out of them, one may lose all that he has invested in business and cry while other may earn much profit to enhance his investment fourfold;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਜੋਈ ਕੁਲਾਧਰਮ ਹੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸੋ ਤੈਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਅਪਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaiso jaiso joiee kulaadharam hai karam karai taiso taiso jas apajas pragaTaavahee ||

en.bdb: Every member of the family works and conducts himself according to the family traditions, and every son earns good or bad name according to the deeds performed by them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪੁਹਪ ਗਤਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਖਾ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਰਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥੩੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise satigur samadharasee puhap gat sikh saakhaa bibidh birakh fal paavahee ||370||

en.bdb: Similarly, the True Guru is like a flower that gives its fragrance to all equally, but because of their lower/higher consciousness, the Sikhs obtain different types of blessings from the Guru. Those who abide by His teachings, benefit; whose who do not, suffer or benefit less.
